name: Kirchhoff's Current Law
expr: concept: sum of currents entering a node equals sum of currents leaving it, ΣIin = ΣIout

name: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law
expr: concept: sum of voltage drops around any closed loop equals zero, ΣV = 0

name: Superposition Theorem
expr: concept: response in a linear circuit with multiple sources equals sum of responses from each source acting alone

name: Thevenin's Theorem

name: Norton's Theorem

expr: concept: maximum power is delivered to the load when load resistance equals the source (Thevenin) resistance

name: Reciprocity Theorem
expr: concept: in a linear passive network, the ratio of response to excitation is unchanged if source and response points are interchanged
